payload.title: Give every user story an outcome metric
payload.body:
The new-project rules (agentbrew #204) say a story metric is an outcome users create, not a count of passing tests. US02, US06, US09, and US10 still use test or repo-internal counts. Replace them with pinned, measurable outcome metrics in docs/metrics.md and scripts/metrics.sh; keep the e2e counts as guards.
- **Hypothesis**: stories with an outcome metric rise from 6/10 to 10/10, and each new metric has a pinned query, a goal, and a pivot.
- **Measurement**: grep "Guard" docs/user-stories/0*.md; bash scripts/metrics.sh
- **Success**: 10/10 stories cite an outcome metric that metrics.sh prints or the event log answers.
- **Pivot**: a story without an outcome source keeps its guard metric with a stated reason.
- **Anchor**: agentbrew skill-plugins/workflow/new-project SKILL.md (user-stories row); Basili et al. 1994 (GQM).
